4279-5931-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5931-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1322-4289-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1336-2085.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-1336-2085.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1336-2085.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1479-2841-6517-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6517-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

880-3875-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

413-549-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
413-549-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it triggers itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve that creature's earthbend ability targeting itself, causing that creature to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untappping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Blasting Station.

803-3413-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6000-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7830-7836.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7836.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5078-5642.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

101-1987-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
101-1987-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-4708-6633.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1978-3263-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat

288-560-2757-3000.description:
Activate Oketra by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior, a 1/1 Soldier and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Warrior, Squirrel or Soldier, untapping a basic Plains.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

341-586-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-5295-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

2743-3130-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-3130-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Blue Sun's Twilight at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Blue Sun's Twilight spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

411-4103-4613-5805.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4613-5805.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

710-2921-2961.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

997-1636-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
997-1636-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Zombie, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1429-5147-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5147-5958.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

67-997-4681.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 2.
Repeat.

914-1368-3698-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard if Dockside Extortionist is in your graveyard.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1368-3698-4050.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist either from your hand by paying {1}{R} or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
The Treasures enter the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station that many times, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing a Treasure, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1558-3263-3413-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
1558-3263-3413-4875.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
The creatures die, triggering Xathrid Necromancer five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

643-1134-1267-3632.notablePrerequisites:
Preeminent Captain does not have summoning sickness.
The opponent(s) being attacked can not block and kill Preeminent Captain.
The opponent(s) being attacked can not block Medomai.
643-1134-1267-3632.description:
Attack with Preeminent Captain, putting Medomai onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Medomai triggers on combat damage, granting you an extra turn.
Tap Erratic Portal, returning Medomai to your hand.
Repeat.

1284-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1284-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Viridian Longbow ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2103-2665-3277.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
2103-2665-3277.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the token Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
